stages.name: Preserve fixed heteroatom frame
operations: Keep core-n-1, core-n-2, and core-b-1 as atoms 1, 2, and 3.
Retain their supplied elements and Cartesian coordinates without displacement.

stages.name: Build the BN MR core
operations: Attach B to the two upper core aryl rings and the top carbon of the central aryl ring.
Attach each tertiary N to its upper aryl, lateral aryl, and central aryl positions.
Place F on the bottom carbon of the fully substituted central aryl ring.

stages.name: Add upper and lateral aryl framework
operations: Add the upper-left biphenyl fragment and both lateral phenyl-substituted aryl rings.
Build the upper-right spirobifluorene using the upper-right core aryl as one fluorene ring.

stages.name: Close lower bridged fluorene units
operations: Add left and right tetrahedral 9-position carbons joining central and lateral aryl carbons.
Attach a fluorene framework and one peripheral phenyl substituent to each lower bridge carbon.

stages.name: Complete and relax geometry
operations: Add all hydrogens explicitly for neutral singlet C105H58BN2F.
Generate ETKDGv3 conformers, fix all three anchors, UFF-relax, and select by clashes then energy.
Verify one connected component and exact anchor coordinates in the written SDF.

notes: The edit-plan schema supplied by the task does not define atom-level commands, so this file records structured high-level construction stages and the principal ring-closure decisions.
